result.summary: Found 1 issue: an invalid '-0%' discount badge displayed on a restaurant card.

issues.description: The second restaurant card under the 'Popular right now' section (the pizza card at the bottom) displays a '-0%' promotional badge in its top-left corner, which indicates a zero-percent discount.
issues.suggestion: Hide or conditionally omit promotional discount badges when the discount value is 0% or less.
